info.description:
API for CVWO forum assignment backend

## Error Responses
All error responses follow a consistent structure with two fields:
- `error_code`: Machine-readable error code (e.g., INVALID_INPUT, USER_NOT_FOUND)
- `error_message`: Human-readable error message

Example: `{"error_code": "INVALID_INPUT", "error_message": "invalid input"}`
